title: fix(ui): keep prose punctuation outside tool links
author: ale-rls
pr_body_excerpt:
- Keeps trailing prose punctuation and unmatched closing parentheses outside tool-detail HTTPS links.
- Preserves balanced URL parentheses, embedded query punctuation and exact double-quoted URL tokens, including JSON values.
- Extends the existing SSR tests: six regressions fail on old source; fixed 17 pass, independently rerun by parent. Full UI suite: 108 pass.
- Full UI typecheck, package build including declarations, and Biome pass after loading existing SDK sources and cached dependencies. No dependency changes.

Fixes #16389

gist.headline: The period knows its place
gist.blurb: Tool-detail links leave sentence punctuation in the sentence. Parentheses that belong to the URL get to stay.
gist.summary: Fixed tool-detail HTTPS link parsing so trailing prose punctuation and unmatched closing parentheses stay outside links, while balanced URL parentheses, query punctuation, and double-quoted URL tokens remain intact.
gist.impact: Clicking a tool-detail link targets the intended URL without swallowing the sentence's punctuation or dropping valid characters from the address.
gist.visual_concept: A cozy code garden represents the tool-detail UI: Polli, wearing tiny editor glasses, gently moves a period outside a glowing URL link while balanced parentheses remain nestled around a code-plant. A small retro terminal makes the link behavior legible without turning the scene into a screenshot.
